title: Chapter 67: The Dandy Boy
content:
Chapter 67: The Dandy Boy

"Little mouse! Why are you running so fast?!"

"It's a rare trip. The scenery along the way is really good!"

"Beautiful scenery needs to be appreciated slowly, do you understand!?"

Before anyone arrives, the sound comes first.

Wu Qing saw that the voice was that of a frivolous young man, coming from the Tengu tribesman wearing gorgeous armor at the front of the Tengu tribe cavalry team.

The rat clan lord now looked like a humble little old man, hunched over, riding a giant lizard to accompany the kobold, with a humble smile on his face and sweating profusely.

When everyone saw this scene, they couldn't help but sigh in their hearts.

The Mouse Lord's arrogance at that moment yesterday was just a kind of catharsis from extreme humility, which was sad and pitiful.

But for such a person, you don't know what terrible things he will do to the weaker ones, and it seems very inappropriate to use the word "pity" on him.

Seeing this scene, Meng frowned and said, "What kind of thing did the Tengu clan send here? Is it to bully me into not taking action?"

According to common sense, if the alliance's army has not yet passed, they should send a more reliable person over. Wait for the army to reach their territory, and then make things difficult according to their mood. This is a reasonable strategy.

Now that the Alliance army has not set off yet, are you sending so many people here to give the Alliance a blow?

The team of Tengu cavalry stopped in the distance, and the Rat Tribe lord came over first with some fear.

"I have met all the lords of the alliance!"

After what happened yesterday, the Rat Lord became very humble now.

"What?! A little boy from the Dog Clan, why do you want so many of our lords to come over to greet him!?"

A lord with a hot temper asked angrily.

Meng said nothing, but his sharp eyes made the rat clan lord tremble in his heart.

"My lords, the one who came this time was a young master from the Tengu clan. He drove away the envoy who came to greet him. I have no choice but to come by myself!"

The voice of the Rat Lord was filled with tears.

Wu Qing took a closer look at the group of Tengu cavalry in the distance. They were truly extraordinary and they were a truly elite group of soldiers.

Wu Qing felt that Meng was on the verge of breaking out. Maybe in the next second he would order the Tiger Cavalry to go up and destroy this group of Tengu cavalry who didn't know the heights of the sky.

The other lords are also filled with righteous indignation, and these lords in the alliance can't stand this kind of anger the most.

In just these few days, Wu Qing met two dandy [wán kù] sons of the Tengu clan. From this, it can be seen that the problem of the Tengu clan is more serious than Meng said.

During such a war, there are still such children wandering around and causing trouble. At least there is a big problem with the education of the Tengu clan.

"Don't worry, we won't make it difficult for you."

"Now that the Tengu clan's support personnel have arrived, let's set off with the army!"

Wu Qing was covered in black armor, riding on a tall war horse, and spoke loudly.

"Haha! OK! The army sets off!"

Hearing Wu Qing's words, he burst into laughter and loudly ordered the army to set off without giving the Rat Lord a chance to speak.

He scolded the horrified Rat Lord again: "What!? You're not leading the way!"

The lords of the alliance also seemed to have let out a bad breath, beamed with joy, and sent farewell to the four lords who were going on the expedition.

The playboy of the Tengu clan, I don’t know what he is thinking in his heart. Maybe he wants to find the feeling of being a master in front of so many lords, or maybe he wants to give the alliance a blow.

Wu Qing didn't have the time to guess what his purpose was. Everyone was here, and if he didn't act according to common sense, the army would just overwhelm him.

Let you have all kinds of thoughts and all kinds of tricks. If I don't communicate with you, it will be useless.

Under Wu Qing's order, 3,000 Zerg puppies served as vanguards and opened the way ahead.

The Zerg puppy rumbled past the Tengu clan's cavalry, deliberately raising smoke and dust in the sky.

The face of the dust-covered young master of the Tengu tribe was so dark that he could drip water. The Lord of the Rat tribe who returned to him was slapped in the face with a whip.

The Rat Tribe lord wiped the blood from his eyes with his hand and said with a smile: "Sir, a good man will not suffer the consequences of his immediate loss. The people here are brutal and fierce. Let's go and lead the way first."

Seeing the terrifying insects running past him, the Tengu clan master finally felt a hint of fear in his heart.

He found that even within the sphere of influence of the Tengu clan, there were people who dared to completely ignore his identity and deny him face, but he himself was powerless.

"Don't you dare give me face! We'll see!"

"Let's go!"

The young master of the Tengu tribe put down his harsh words and led the Tengu tribe's cavalry to the front of the marching army.

He privately drove away the messenger, and it was okay to complete the mission. If he messed up the mission, he would also face punishment due to his status.

The alliance's expedition team was led by the Zerg in front and the Zerg in the rear. Wu Qing and the four lords Meng, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan led 5,000 elite troops and logistics teams from each territory in the center, and moved rapidly toward the northeast of the Tiger Territory. march.

A group of puppies always surrounded the supporting Tengu cavalry. Only the Rat Lord was allowed to go to the rear to communicate with Wu Qing and others, while the others were chased away like ducks.

The young master of the Tengu clan had never been so aggrieved before. He had a dark face and remained silent. The unfortunate Lord of the Rat clan ran forward and back, and was beaten bloody by him.

It is indeed a tragedy for a lord to live like this.

On this way, as the young master of the Tengu tribe said, the scenery is very good. Wherever the army passes, hundreds of beasts run, which is very spectacular.

Finally, he is going to a bigger battlefield. Wu Qing is in a very good mood. He is accompanied by ten heavy-armored insect knights. He rides his horse and enjoys the scenery along the way. It is very comfortable.

Meng, Yu Chong and Bai Yan, the three lords, have to pay attention to the march at all times. They only come to meet Wu Qing occasionally and chat together.

"You don't need to worry about the march of the insect army. You live a carefree life!"

Meng is a little envious of Wu Qing's current state. He feels that there is nothing difficult in front of Wu Qing, and everything is very calm.

Yu Chong and Bai Yan have more contact with Wu Qing and have some understanding of Wu Qing.

The four of them walked and talked together. Not long after, Meng and the others left and went to the marching team. It was the first time for the five logistics teams to conduct such a high-intensity march. Not to mention that there were many problems, there were also many problems.

This walk lasted more than three hours, without any rest stops in the middle. This was the longest march and the longest distance since Wu Qing came to this world.

If it were not for the drag, with the marching speed of the Zerg, it should be possible to save nearly half of the time.

The Zerg troops are not afraid of fatigue, and the elite troops of each territory can also withstand such an intense march. Although the logistics team has a lot of problems, the endurance of those giant lizards is very strong. Under the condition of not carrying much weight, such a march can also be supported.

Only the young man of the Tiangou tribe was driven by a puppy like a duck to walk such a long distance, and his mentality had already collapsed.

Seeing that the destination was about to arrive, tears filled my eyes.
